title: docs(skills): teach a handler hook's refusals, a code's reasons and params
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGooifXpuUREdsVd5x9prTS)_

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o9NG21PoQGHjYvjzM

Fixes #33658

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据技能 `data-hooks.md` 的「声明式拒绝」一节改为教 #33214 之后的真实规则:`handler` 钩子也能声明 `refusals`;同一个码下可以有多句 `reasons`(抛 `{ code, reason }`);声明 `params` 后句子里的双花括号占位符只能引用已声明的名字。i18n 技能在原有翻译键旁加上 reasons 的翻译键。
- 为什么改:PR #33641 合并后,旧文档仍说「只有沙箱 JS 能声明拒绝、一码一句、不许占位符」,AI 照着写会继续抛英文句子或自造错误码。
- 风险与回滚:只改两份技能文档加一个 changeset,无代码;为付 token 棘轮删了同文件内四处重复说明。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` 的 `### Declared refusals` 一节(示例与下方 5 条要点);其次 `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的 App-authored 一条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 全绿,data-hooks.md 为 9990/10011。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(按低风险 skills 臂;臂若读出 Tier H 则需你批准合并)。

## What changes

Three files, no code.

**`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` § Declared refusals (`refusals`)**

- The example's `ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK` entry now declares `params: ['due']` and a `reasons` entry `on_loan` whose sentence fills a `due` hole, and the body throws `Object.assign(new Error(), { code: 'ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK', reason: 'on_loan', params: { due: asset.due_date } })` before the existing code-only throw.
- "Only a `js` `body` can declare one: a `handler` hook, inline TS included, is refused at save" is replaced: a `js` body or a `handler` (inline or named) can declare one; an `expression` body, or neither, is refused at save.
- New bullets: `reasons` are snake_case, thrown as `reason`, and keep the code's wire `code` and status; `params` names what a hole may fill, and a hole over any other name, or any hole with no `params`, is refused.
- The translation bullet names both keys, `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.message` and `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.reasons.REASON.message`, and says the thrown text (not "the body's own text") is unused.
- The refusal bullet adds "a reason missing from a code's `reasons`".
- The intro says "the hook throws the code" instead of "its body throws the code".

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` § Server-Composed User Text**: the App-authored bullet names `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.reasons.REASON.message` beside the code's key, and says a translation of a sentence whose entry declares `params` keeps its holes, filled by the runtime after it is picked.

**`.changeset/33658-skills-hook-refusal-reasons-params.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (the catalog ships in `@objectstack/skills`).

**Token ratchet payment (same file, restatements only).** data-hooks.md was at 10004/10011; the new text cost about 150 tokens. Removed:

| Removed | Its home in the same file |
|:--|:--|
| "The deprecated `handler` takes an inline function or a registered function's name (Registration Methods)." | the `body` vs `handler` table (inline) and Registration Methods 1 (string name via `functions`) |
| "So spell keys against the object's declared fields, and on an insert event read `previous` only against `null` ..." | the paragraph above it (a typo'd key and a `previous` column on an insert fail the write) and the `previous is null on insert` bullet |
| "(A declarative `condition` does not hit this wall ...)" under Gotcha 1 | § `condition`: "`record` here is the RECORD ... unlike `ctx.input` / `ctx.result` inside the body, which stay partial, see Gotcha 1" |
| "Register it like any hook, add it to `defineStack({ hooks: [...] })` ..." after the copy-paste example | Registration Methods 1 (`defineStack({ hooks })`, `AppPlugin` auto-binds) |

No ceiling moved. `i18n.sourceLocale` teaching is untouched (#33635 holds it).

## Why

PR #33641 (#33214, ruling 6879477573) made `HookSchema` and the runtime accept `refusals` on a handler hook, `reasons` under a code and declared `params`. The skills still taught the pre-#33641 rule, so an agent would keep a hand-written body for every rule, one sentence per code and no params.

## Tests

No test file is committed (skills text only). Two one-time checks of the new example, both against `main` @ `12a0f09f` built under the lock:

<details><summary>HookSchema.parse on the published example and six mutants (packages/spec dist)</summary>

```
example parse: true
hole over undeclared name: refused: refusals.ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK.reasons.on_loan.message A hook refusal `message` binds only `due` ...
hole with no params: refused: refusals.ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK.reasons.on_loan.message A hook refusal `message` whose entry declares no `params` is plain text ...
literal undeclared reason: refused: body.source `body.source` throws code 'ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK' with reason 'lost' ...
inline handler + refusals: ACCEPTED
inline handler, undeclared reason: refused: handler `handler` throws code 'ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK' with reason 'lost' ...
string handler + refusals: ACCEPTED
expression body + refusals: refused: refusals `refusals` is answered for a sandboxed `body` ...
```

The block was read out of the edited markdown file, not retyped. Each bullet's claim has a mutant above.
</details>

<details><summary>Real QuickJS run of the example's throw lines (scratch test beside hook-refusal-catalogue.test.ts, deleted after)</summary>

The body was bound through `hookBodyRunnerFactory` + `QuickJSScriptRunner` with the hook passed through `HookSchema.parse`; the one `ctx.api` read was swapped for an input value, every throw line kept as published. `Tests 5 passed (5)`, exit 0.

```
ON_LOAN {"status":409,"body":{"error":"This asset is on loan until 2026-12-01.","code":"RESOURCE_CONFLICT","declaredCode":"ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK","object":"asset_checkout","userMessage":"This asset is on loan until 2026-12-01."}}
ZH {"status":409,"body":{"error":"该资产借出至 2026-12-01。","code":"RESOURCE_CONFLICT","declaredCode":"ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK","object":"asset_checkout","userMessage":"该资产借出至 2026-12-01。"}}
RETIRED {"status":409,"body":{"error":"Only an in-stock asset can be checked out.","code":"RESOURCE_CONFLICT","declaredCode":"ASSET_NOT_IN_STOCK","object":"asset_checkout","userMessage":"Only an in-stock asset can be checked out."}}
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

Each taught rule, read from `main` @ `12a0f09f`:

| Taught | Read from |
|:--|:--|
| a `js` body or a `handler` (inline or string) may declare `refusals`; `expression` body or neither refused at `refusals` | `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` `refuseUndeclaredLiteralRefusalCode` (`answered = body === undefined ? hasHandler : language === 'js'`) |
| reasons snake_case, thrown as `reason`, keep the code's status and wire code | `HOOK_REFUSAL_REASON_PATTERN` (`hook-refusal-codes.ts`); `HookRefusalSchema` `reasons` describe; runtime `declaredAnswer` |
| a hole only over a declared param; no `params` means no hole | `hookRefusalMessageRefusal` (`closedScopeTemplateRefusal` with `roots: params`) |
| literal undeclared code or reason refused at save, else a 500 | `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` / `hookRefusalReasonsThrownIn`; runtime `undeclaredHookRefusalReasonAtRun` |
| reason key, and a translation keeps its holes | `hookRefusalMessageKey` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts`); `translation.zod.ts` `hooks` docblock |

Out of scope, noted for the seat (not filed): the objectstack-data eval `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` id 7 `expected_output` still ends "a catalogue on a hook without a `js` body is refused at save", which #33641 made false (a `handler` hook may declare one). Its assertions (`must_contain`, `must_not_contain`) are unaffected. carrier: the skills seat.
